Package overview

Applr-package Applr
Applr: Tools for Visualizing and Explaining Linear Models

Plot model slices with ggplot2

The geom_slice layer, its labeling companions, and the one-call autoplot.

geom_slice()
Display a 2D slice of a linear model
geom_slice_text()
Label the lines drawn by geom_slice()
geom_slice_subtitle()
Describe the lines drawn by geom_slice() in the plot subtitle
geom_slice_caption()
Describe the lines drawn by geom_slice() in the plot caption
autoplot(<lm>)
Automatically plot a linear model

Base graphics

2D Slicer
add_slice_2d()

3-D view

scatter_3d()

lm_latex()
